column1: # The modern look's car materials, by hand: which finish each part of each car texture has.
# One row per line, tab-separated:   TEXTURE   PRESET   [RECT]   [COLOURS]
#   TEXTURE  a texture's name without folder or extension (CM11MDL1), ? for one character, * for any run. Cars' paint schemes
#            number their textures (AL11MDL1..4) with the same layout, so one row with a ? serves them all. Shared textures
#            (the weapon gizmos, GMLP*) are named once.
#   PRESET   one of the names below.
#   RECT     x,y,w,h in the texture's texels (the .m16 as the PPM sheets show it, origin top left), or * for the whole texture.
#   COLOURS  colour classes joined with |, a leading ! negates one; a texel must be in one of them. * for any.
#            any black dark grey light white glass red orange yellow green blue colour (see CarMaterialTable.InClass).
# Rows apply in file order, a later row over an earlier one, to the texels its rectangle and colours pick: first a texture's base
# row (no rectangle, no colours), then its regions. A texture no row names is not in the table and keeps the all-over clear coat.
# A respray recolours only the texels whose preset is a paint (gloss-paint, metallic-paint, satin-paint, matte-paint).
# '#' starts a comment. Review with: i76 car-table sheet OUT_DIR (the textures beside their preset colours), and the game's
# I76_CAR_MATERIAL_IDS=1 (the cars drawn in their presets' colours).
# Presets (roughness, metallic, clear coat; colours on the review sheets in CarMaterialTable.Presets):
#   gloss-paint      clear-coated paint (what every car texture has until listed)
#   metallic-paint   paint with flake under the coat
#   satin-paint      semi-matt paint, a faded or utility finish
#   matte-paint      flat paint, no coat: military, primer
#   chrome           polished plating: bumpers, trim, hubcaps
#   steel            bare or brushed metal: engine, exhaust, guns, grille bars
#   chassis-steel    dull painted or oily steel: underside, axles, frame
#   liner            a pickup bed's ribbed spray-on liner
#   lens             head, tail and signal lamp lenses
#   vinyl            vinyl and leather: seats, door cards
#   canvas           canvas and cloth: tilts, tarps, carpets
# For now only these are listed (2026-10-27): the hand-drawn regions were not accurate enough, so every other car keeps the
# all-over clear coat until the parts can be picked out reliably (e.g. segmenting rendered views and projecting back onto the textures).
# the Hacienda's bed (a clear coat over the ribbed black mirrored the sky in streaks, #123)
# ---- Goon (GO11): the army jeep, camouflaged -- flat paint, no coat, all over ------------------------------------------------
# the Leopard XLC's convertible top (the segmentation takes the whole canopy for glass): the cloth, the blue panels stay windows
# the hearse's curtained windows (the segmentation takes them for glass): all cloth, the folds' dark gaps too, and the black frame round
# them its paint (it was glass, so the curtained window read as one long window with the door's)
# the Limo's rear window (the segmentation misses it): the blue pane above the trunk
# the Sovereign's left side (the roof texture's right edge): the front door window and the wing window before it, both missed by the
# segmentation, so the dark blue panes read as body (the rear door window below is found)
# and the rear door window's lower outer corner, squared off (the cut corner left a one-texel tail the straightening trimmed into a slanted edge, a light wedge along the window's rear)
# the Moth cab (Cargo Truck, Loadmaster): the rear window into the cabin and the side window's darker wrap-round strip (the segmentation misses both)
# the milk tanker's wrap-round corner window (its darker half missed)
# the school bus (Winston High): the segmentation takes its black bands, the dark round the grille and the lettering for glass;
# only the windshield (front) and the emergency door's two panes (back) are windows
# the school bus's orange window pillars (the trim prompts took them for chrome)
# the Phaedra Rattler's windshield, the dark band across its roof texture (the segmentation took only its highlight)
# and the sliver along the black band beside the windows (rows 31-32: the segmentation reached into it; in the game it cut the pillars short)
# the Piranha's side windows: a dark line along the pane split off a thin sliver of glass, which drew as a stripe across the window
# the Palomino's side windows: the darker strip along the bottom of the pane's rear corner was left out, a sliver under the glass
# the Jackrabbit's left front quarter light (the segmentation found the right one only)
# the Piranha's black stripes across its tail (the segmentation took them for windows): paint
# the Royale's side windows run to their bottom edge (the roof texture's outer columns): the texel or two along it was left out and drew as a light sliver
# the Limo's side windows run to their bottom edge (the roof texture's outer columns, each pane apart): the texels along it drew as light slivers
# the Moth Truck's and milk tanker's cab rear window (the tanker's projection, where its tank hides it, overwrote the truck's map)
